question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Sow wild oats
solution:
The correct answer is **"Engaging in rebelliousness or promiscuity."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"sow wild oats"** means to engage in reckless and irresponsible behavior, especially in terms of sexual promiscuity. (लापरवाह और गैर-जिम्मेदाराना व्यवहार में शामिल होना, खासकर यौन स्वच्छंदता के मामले में)

 
 
• **Example**: *Paul asked his father if he had **sowed his wild oats**__ before getting married.*
 
 
 
• The phrase originates from the idea of sowing wild oats as a metaphor for sowing one's wild and youthful energy before settling down.
 
• This idiom is often used to describe young men who engage in promiscuous behavior before they are ready to commit to a serious relationship.
